verdict.rationale: An AI app builder with a built-in database could plausibly offer AI insights over a user's data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no feature that analyzes user or app data to produce insights or suggestions. Plan Mode (Q&A about the project) and security scanning concern code, not data, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
